module.name: CHU Blida Theme
module.author: CERIST / CHU Blida
module.description: Branding and user-experience layer for Centre Hospitalo-Universitaire de Blida. Presentation only: no clinical logic, no schema changes, no upstream module is modified. Stopping this module restores the stock OpenMRS appearance immediately.

globalProperty.description: Master switch. Set to false to disable all theming without stopping the module.
Stamp dir="rtl" on the html element for right-to-left locales such as Arabic. The Reference Application does not do this itself.
Cache-busting suffix appended to injected asset URLs. Change this after editing a stylesheet in place so browsers pick up the new file.

Comma-separated URL fragments the injection filter must leave completely alone, in addition to the built-in exclusions (/ws/, /dwr/, static assets, fragment actions, and any request whose Sec-Fetch-Dest is not a document). Example: /adminui/systemadmin/,/myreports/ Lets a page be taken out of the filter's path immediately, without a rebuild and without disabling the whole theme.
